title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-116-26二模

items.zh: 农贸市场里,色泽鲜亮、汁水充足的西红柿随处可见。
items.en: Vibrant, juicy tomatoes are on display everywhere in the farmers’ market.

items.zh: 该品牌从传统编织工艺中汲取灵感,推出了马年新春系列。
items.en: Drawing inspiration from traditional weaving techniques, the brand rolled out its Spring Festival Collection for the Year of the Horse.

items.zh: 越来越多咖啡店推出自带杯优惠,咖啡爱好者每月都能省下一笔不小的开销。discount)
items.en: A growing number of cafes are offering discounts for BYO-cup customers, so coffee lovers can save a considerable amount of money every month.

items.zh: 为推动教育改革,李教授创立了自动化技术研究中心,开设机器人课程,以便学生在做中学,在探索中创新。
items.en: To promote education reform, Professor Li founded the Automation Technology Research Center and introduced robotics courses, so that students can learn by doing and innovate through exploration.
